working_tree_state.identity_note: Release candidate is identified by the base commit plus the staged Git tree and this self-excluded manifest. The Phase 1 report is removed from the release tree while its local working copy and the four excluded internal implementation-inventory reports remain untracked.

scope_note: Release-candidate tree relative to base commit 2ad86b05ca82181da78b3eb6bfee5598d63dc8af. File hashes use Git-normalized blob contents from the staged index; the removed Phase 1 report carries its base-tree blob hash. Includes all unchanged tracked files and approved modified/added files, except that report and the four excluded internal implementation-inventory artifacts. The manifest is self-excluded and does not embed its own hash. Ignored local secrets, databases, virtual environments, dependencies, generated build/test/cache output, and other ignored state are excluded. No production data is included.

hash_normalization_policy: Hash exact Git blob bytes after Git clean filters and line-ending normalization. For paths present in the release index, read the staged index blob. For removed paths, read the base-commit tree blob. The manifest path is self-excluded; no manifest self-hash is stored.

generation_provenance.source: Git index blob contents for release-present paths; base-tree blob for removed paths.
generation_provenance.reproducibility: Deterministic JSON serialization in UTF-8 with LF line endings; no volatile generation timestamp.
